details: The Producer Price Index (PPI) for June came in lower than expected, with a 0.3% monthly decrease and an annual rate of 5.5% (below consensus of 6.2%). This follows softer Consumer Price Index (CPI) data from the previous day, where annual inflation slowed to 3.5% (below analyst forecasts of 3.8%). These figures are easing expectations for immediate Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, leading to a risk-on sentiment in financial markets and supporting cryptocurrency prices. Bitcoin briefly hit a three-week high of $65,500.
title: US Inflation Cools, Boosting Crypto Prices

details: Military tensions between the United States and Iran have intensified, with US forces launching strikes and Iran responding. Reports also indicate two Emirati oil tankers were hit by Iranian missiles in the Strait of Hormuz, pushing WTI crude oil prices above $80 a barrel. This geopolitical uncertainty is weighing on overall investor risk appetite, causing some pressure on Bitcoin and other risk-sensitive assets despite the positive inflation news.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Weighing on Risk Assets

details: The Bank of Korea (BOK) has raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.75%. This move is aimed at curbing inflation and stabilizing the economy. Such tightening monetary policy by a major central bank can impact crypto market liquidity and risk appetite, particularly in Asian markets, by making traditional assets more attractive.
title: Bank of Korea Hikes Interest Rates to Combat Inflation
